summary: A fixed/pinned orchestrator delegates bounded work to Pi workers that use normal Bifrost routing.

requires.orchestratorSkill: A delegation skill or equivalent operating discipline
requires.bifrost: Installed and configured in target project workers
manualAssumptions: Outer orchestrator can be pinned or bypass Bifrost for its session.
Worker Pi sessions load target project's Bifrost config.
Observed model selection can be inspected through public Pi/Bifrost status, preview, or debug surfaces.

acceptance: Outer orchestrator remains on explicitly chosen model for full run.
At least one worker visibly loads Bifrost and reports/records an observed route.
No worker silently replays failed work.
Run feedback contains no prompt body, credential, or provider response.
